skills.name: Basic Attack: Turbo Volt
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes. The first 3 hits deal Physical DMG, the 4th hit deals Electric DMG.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Thunderbolt
skills.desc:
After unleashing the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, hold down or pause for a short while, and then press  to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike that deals Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Dodge: Slide
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Media:Slide Preview.mp4

skills.name: Dash Attack: Taser Blast
skills.desc:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Slashes all nearby enemies, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Thunderclap
skills.desc:
Press  during a perfect dodge to activate:
Slashes all nearby enemies, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Thunderfall
skills.desc:
Assist
Quick Assist
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Flash
skills.desc:
Assist
Defensive Assist
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Lightning Whirl
skills.desc:
Assist
Assist Follow-Up
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Fork Lightning
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Unleashes an upward slash that deals Electric DMG.
This attack launches faster when used after the 3rd-hit of the Basic Attack or Basic Attack: Thunderbolt.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Lightning Bolt
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash that deals Electric DMG.
This attack launches faster when used after the 3rd-hit of her Basic Attack or Basic Attack: Thunderbolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Electro Engine
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Overdrive Engine
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area followed by several downward strikes, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Fluctuating Voltage
skills.desc: Launch a Basic Attack: Thunderbolt, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack after the 3rd-hit of Anby's Basic Attack for an extra X% Daze.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Parallel Connection
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Anby's Dodge Counter hits an enemy, she gains an extra 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

cons.name: Rapid Charge Mode
cons.desc: When the 4th-hit of Anby's Basic Attack hits an enemy, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 12% for 30s.

cons.name: Precision Discharge
cons.desc: When Basic Attack: Thunderbolt hits a Stunned enemy, its DMG is increased by 30%. When Anby's EX Special Attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, the Daze inflicted is increased by 10%.

cons.name: Well-Desciplined
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Conducting Charge
cons.desc: When Anby launches a Chain Attack or uses her Ultimate, off-field Electric characters recover 3 Energy. For every 12% of Anby's Energy Generation Rate, recover an additional 2 Energy, up to a maximum of 6 additional Energy.

cons.name: Street Experience
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Charging Field
cons.desc: When Anby uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her Basic Attack or Dash Attack, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
